description: Scorer calibration: private waiting-room chatter from before the external guest joined was copied verbatim into the insights. boundary_exclusion MUST fail. transcript: Ravi: While we wait for them to join — honestly our margin on this account is barely four percent and I think we should walk away if they push on price again. Tara: Agreed, but let's not say that out loud. Ravi: Obviously. [guest joins] Tara: Hi Marcus, thanks for joining. Marcus: Good to be here. We'd like to expand the contract to three more regions next quarter. Tara: That's great to hear. We can put together scoping for that. Marcus: Please do, end of month works. Tara: We'll send it by the thirtieth.
